full_judgment: 3. Defendant No.1, (petitioner herein) filed written statement in the suit contending inter alia that the suit is not maintainable and the same is barred by limitation. It is further stated that the agreement was execute on 07.01.2002 with the Managing Director of Bangladesh Oil Field Services Ltd. to sell the suit property, Mr. Ahmedul Ameen, in his personal capacity. Subsequently, an additional deed of agreement was executed between the said Managing Director and defendant No.1 stipulating that 6th floor of the suit building, instead of 7th floor, would be transferred to him keeping other terms and conditions of the earlier contract intact. It is further stated that after the death of the said Managing Director, the defendant No.1 approached his widow and also approached Mr. Masud Sadik, the Directors of the said company to take step for execution and registration of deed of sale but they failed to do the same and as such it was not possible for the said defendant to execute and register the deed of sale. Accordingly, the defendant No.1 prayed that the plaintiff is not entitled to get any relief
